criteria.requirement: Preserve the authoritative user outcome and acceptance across sessions and changes.
criteria.check: Continue an interrupted task whose convenient checks pass while its requested consumer outcome remains incomplete; acceptance must remain open until delivered.

criteria.requirement: Reflection produces executed corrective work with independent outcome evidence.
criteria.check: An actual observed discrepancy triggers a feasible correction and fresh consumer verification; reflection text and gate exit alone cannot establish improvement.

criteria.requirement: Prior evidence supports only the candidate and observations it actually tested.
criteria.check: Modify relevant source, requirements or supporting evidence after verification; previous success must no longer establish current acceptance.

criteria.requirement: Review detects an incorrect frame independently of the builder.
criteria.check: Retain criteria derived from original authority before implementation exposure; altered framing or acceptance requires renewed review against original authority.
A healthy no-gap task should finish with necessary checks, without mandatory reflection prose, extra agents or redundant trial work.

criteria.requirement: Native recurrence experiments are uncoached and preserve trial integrity.
criteria.check: Freeze identities, observe real host execution, bind scoring to that run result, retain retries and assistance, and keep the external oracle unavailable to workers.

criteria.requirement: Claims distinguish mechanics, behavior, continuation and limitations.
criteria.check: Report deterministic test results separately from fresh/resumed native behavior, actual host-hook invocation, and unrun or blocked acceptance.
